does: Evaluates the dice of an expression (RCX a RollDefinition: +0x0 the die, +0x1 the count, +0x4 the modifier, +0x8 negative): with R8 zero it rolls them through RollManager::RollDice on the stream of the context at +0x50; with R8 set it returns the whole-number average, (faces+1) times count halved and rounded down, plus the modifier.

evidence.says: It calls the roll manager's plain dice roll with the context's maximise flag
the two branches on R8; the average branch shifts (faces+1)*count right by one

in goblins' turns it is called with R8 set from esv::AiHelpers::CalculateAiScoreStatsFunctors (+0x3112475), and with R8 zero from unplaced::ExecuteApplyStatusFunctor (+0x377BF00) for a RollDefinition of no dice and modifier 1: the duration of IF(not Player(context.Source)):ApplyStatus(SELF,AI_HELPER_EXTRAATTACK,100,1) in Target_MainHandAttack's SpellProperties, which is the roll of no dice on the Generic stream after a creature's attack

questions.ask: Which expressions come through here, seen with a probe
